anchor_value: source schedule presents Cost and Fair Value in dollar columns; EUR/AUD labels apply to Par/Shares

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Hamilton Thorne, Inc. | Health Care Equipment & Supplies | 8.28 % | E + 5.50 % | 11/28/31 | EUR | 11,492 | 12,299 | 12,177
Sonar Acquisitionco, Inc. (dba SimPRO) | Construction & Engineering | 8.90 % | B + 4.75 % | 10/24/30 | AUD | 5,600 | 3,683 | 3,464

Par amount is presented for debt investments, while the number of shares or units owned is presented for equity investments. Par amount is denominated in U.S. Dollars ("$" or "USD") unless otherwise noted, Australian Dollars ("AUD"), or Euros ("EUR").

findings.detail: Hamilton Thorne carries EUR in the Par/Shares currency slot, but Cost and Fair Value remain dollar-denominated; fair_value_currency should not be U_EUR.
Sonar Acquisitionco carries AUD in the Par/Shares currency slot, but Cost and Fair Value remain dollar-denominated; fair_value_currency should not be U_AUD.

rationale: FX02 is a Class 1 row-level currency flag. The raw SOI has separate columns for Par/Shares, Cost, and Fair Value. The foreign currency labels EUR and AUD appear in the Par/Shares area for the cited rows, and footnote (4) explains that these alternate currencies qualify par/share amounts. The Cost and Fair Value columns are dollar columns, so storing U_EUR or U_AUD as fair_value_currency is a localized extraction/column mapping error.
